result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, matching the sales-rep list.

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). I copied the `CASE` ordering from `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep` and updated the Javadoc to say so. `RegionManagerService.overviewFor` is the only caller, so nothing else changes.

`mvn -q -o test -Dtest=RegionManagerTest,RegionReportTest,SupportTicketTest` passed with no output. I did not add a test that pins the new order for the T-1…T-5 example, and I did not commit.
